description:
Creates the custom field with this `key`, or updates it if the company already has one.
Repeating the request leaves the same state, so it is safe to run on every deployment to
seed a catalogue.

- **Status:** `201` when the field is created, `200` when it already existed.
- **Key:** it is the path, never the body, and it never changes. To stop using a field,
  archive it (`is_archived: true`); fields are never deleted.
- **Archive state:** omitting `is_archived` keeps the current one, so repeating the
  request never reactivates a field someone archived.
- **Suggestions:** omitting `suggest_values` keeps the current setting; a new field starts
  with `true`. Use `false` for a value that changes on every invoice, such as an order
  number: invoices store the text as sent and no options are created. Turning it off
  deletes no option, and turning it back on offers them again.
- **Options:** the response carries the common options of the field, or none when
  `suggest_values` is `false`.

BeeL API endpoint: PUT /v1/companies/{company_id}/custom-fields/{key} (reference: https://docs.beel.es)

CustomFieldKey.description: Identifier of the custom field within the company, chosen when the field is created: lowercase letters, digits and `_`, up to 64 characters. It never changes. BeeL. gives it no meaning of its own.

UpsertCustomFieldRequest.description: The state of the custom field. `label` and `show_on_pdf` are always replaced. `suggest_values` and `is_archived`, when omitted, keep their current value (a new field is created with `suggest_values: true` and active), so repeating a request never undoes a change someone made to them.

is_archived.description: `true` archives the field, `false` reactivates it. Omit it to keep the current state.

label.description: Name people see next to the value. Leading and trailing spaces are removed; a label that is empty after that answers `422`.

show_on_pdf.description: Whether the PDF of invoices saved from now on prints this field.

suggest_values.description: `true` offers the values already used as options and adds new ones as invoices are saved; `false` stores each value as sent and creates no options. Omit it to keep the current setting; a new field starts with `true`. Turning it off deletes no option.

company_id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the company the operation acts on — its identifier, not its NIF. It is the only source of context: the account that owns it is derived from it, and the `BeeL-Active-Company` header plays no part. A company you do not reach answers `403`, and so does a company that does not exist, so the existence of a company in another account is never disclosed.

key.description: Key of the custom field: lowercase letters, digits and `_`, up to 64 characters. A key outside that format answers `422`.

name: beel_upsert_custom_field
